review.why: Writes product management resumes that show decisions and tradeoffs with accurate attribution and metric definitions.
review.summary: Separates product from project management, then gathers the problem, discovery evidence, owned decisions, constraints and what shipped. Evidence prompts cover discovery, growth, platform, enterprise and senior roles; adoption stays apart from total users and metric windows are kept. The example separates percentage points from percent.
strengths: Credits a team launch to the team, not to the individual
Does not add SQL or research skills just because a posting names them
Worked example distinguishes an observed change from a proven lift
cautions: Instructions only: no templates or scripts
Delivery governance is left to the project-manager skill
